<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Game initialization
    const game = {
      map: {
        width: 10,
        height: 10,
        tiles: new Array(10).fill(0)
      },
      players: [
        { id: 0, position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, direction: 'right' },
        { id: 1, position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, direction: 'left' }
      ],
      ai: {
        players: [
          { id: 0, behavior: 'expand', target: { x: 1, y: 1 } },
          { id: 1, behavior: 'defend', target: { x: 9, y: 9 } }
        ]
      },
      state: {
        saved: false,
        progress: 0,
        economy: 0
      }
    };

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      // Update AI behavior
      game.ai.players.forEach(player => {
        if (player.behavior === 'expand') {
          player.position.x += 1;
        } else if (player.behavior === 'defend') {
          player.position.x -= 1;
        }
      });

      // Update player movement
      game.players.forEach(player => {
        if (player.direction === 'right') {
          player.position.y += 1;
        } else if (player.direction === 'left') {
          player.position.y -= 1;
        }
      });

      // Check for collisions
      game.map.tiles.forEach((tile, index) => {
        if (tile === 1) {
          // Collision detected
        }
      });

      // Update game state
      game.state.progress += 1;
      game.state.economy += 1;

      // Check for win/loss
      if (game.state.progress === 100) {
        alert("You win!");
      } else if (game.state.economy === 100) {
        alert("You lose!");
      }

      // Save state
      game.state.saved = true;
    }

    // Start game
    gameLoop();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
